incumbent.text: Streaming canonicalization with an on-disk key index: normalize every reference to a scope-qualified key, register keys and perform unions in SQLite while a compact array-backed disjoint set stays in memory, derive one HMAC(seed, root) token per component, and re-stream each CSV applying the policy. Measure peak RSS and validate cross-file token equality.

hint: A local CSV anonymizer must map references to one stable token per underlying entity. Ten tables use tenant-local IDs and scope-qualified handles; alias rows connect actor and account handles to person and account references; cross-tenant link rows connect people; effective-dated merge rows connect actor handles to people. The policy also requires format-preserving fake values, hashes, masks, redaction, and numeric noise, with deterministic seeded output and a 64 MB peak-RSS cap over about two million rows. The agent may read a disposable copy, create fixtures, write outputs, and run Python; no official verifier is available. The first question is whether per-key hashing without global components is sufficient, or whether transitive components are load-bearing.
